headline: Embry-Riddle end Rollins' unbeaten start
dek: Embry-Riddle went to Rollins and won, the season's first result between SSC sides, and stay unbeaten after three wins and a draw. Eleven scored and five conceded; Rollins had not lost until then.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The goals are pooled at the top of the chart, not spread through it: Florida Southern alone have outscored Barry, Eckerd and Nova Southeastern put together, and have conceded once while doing it.

wire.line: Barry are the only side yet to win, with a draw and two defeats before conference play opens.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches have passed their date with no result: Palm Beach Atlantic's against Florida Atlantic, Barry and Strive Academy, Eckerd's against Trinity, and Saint Leo's at home to Florida Southern, which is listed again for today.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Tampa's first win came at home to Harding after two draws and a defeat; they have scored ten and conceded six.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Rollins' first defeat was at home to Embry-Riddle; they have scored eleven and conceded ten, more than any other programme has let in.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Lynn are still unbeaten and have drawn three in a row away from home since beating Mississippi College in their opener.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ricardo Marques has kept three clean sheets for Florida Southern and conceded one goal.

last_match.line: Rollins' first defeat of the season; Embry-Riddle remain unbeaten.

next_match.line: Florida Southern have yet to drop a point; Saint Leo are unbeaten at home.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
